# Dependency Parser

> An arc-standard, transition-based dependency parser built from scratch: a static oracle, an averaged structured perceptron policy, greedy decoding, and attachment-score evaluation.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/dependency-parser

## Source

- [src/dependency_parser/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/dependency-parser/blob/main/src/dependency_parser/__init__.py): Dependency Parser - an arc-standard transition-based parser, from scratch.
- [src/dependency_parser/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/dependency-parser/blob/main/src/dependency_parser/cli.py): Command line interface for the dependency parser.
- [src/dependency_parser/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/dependency-parser/blob/main/src/dependency_parser/data.py): A deterministic, projective dependency treebank generated from a known grammar.
- [src/dependency_parser/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/dependency-parser/blob/main/src/dependency_parser/evaluation.py): Attachment-score evaluation for the dependency parser.
- [src/dependency_parser/features.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/dependency-parser/blob/main/src/dependency_parser/features.py): Feature templates over an arc-standard configuration.
- [src/dependency_parser/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/dependency-parser/blob/main/src/dependency_parser/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service (Prometheus text exposition).
- [src/dependency_parser/parser.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/dependency-parser/blob/main/src/dependency_parser/parser.py): The greedy transition based parser: training loop and decoding.
- [src/dependency_parser/perceptron.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/dependency-parser/blob/main/src/dependency_parser/perceptron.py): An averaged structured perceptron over transition decisions.
- [src/dependency_parser/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/dependency-parser/blob/main/src/dependency_parser/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the trained dependency parser.
- [src/dependency_parser/transitions.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/dependency-parser/blob/main/src/dependency_parser/transitions.py): The arc-standard transition system and its static oracle.
